scope: Two independent diagnostics with the same complete retained source and candidates, plus eight independent contrast cases. Original production and review failures remain unchanged.
comparisonBasis: Development-agent interpretation of action ownership, not a blinded quality rating. Counts cover ownership judgments only.
finding: Codex identified all four original actor/player ownership mismatches. Agnes identified two, and still misattributed two other directions; one control misidentified the declared NPC. Both calls succeeded. This is a semantic reliability gap, not an API configuration or quota failure.
